caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on an off-white or beige background. The chair is brown and consists of four outwardly splayed legs, a flat seat, and an ornately carved backrest featuring symmetrical curved cutouts and a small heart-shaped cutout near the upper center. The drawing is minimally composed, with no other objects or elements present. Beneath the chair, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is written in a small, simple font. The entire composition is centered with ample empty space surrounding the chair.
title: Pa. German Chair
